raw_segments.text: Here, cried Starbuck, seizing stub by the shoulder and pointing his hand towards the
weather bow, Mark is thou not that the gale comes from the eastward, the very course Ahab
is to run for Moby Dick, the very course he swung to this day noon.
Now mark his boat there, where is that stove?
In the stern-sheets, man, where he is want to stand, his standpoint is stove, man.
Now jump overboard and sing away, if thou must.
